messages:
nina: quick copy check for the rate-limit tooltip on the dashboard. want something short, actionable, and accessible. current tooltip: "Rate limit reached. Try again later."

nina: concerns: too vague (how long?), not actionable (retry when?), and shows up on hover which is not great for keyboard users.

rafi: agree. maybe include retry cooldown and a link to upgrade docs. suggestion:
"You hit your rate limit. Try again in 1m. Want higher throughput? Upgrade plan or request a quota increase."

jules: i like including the cooldown. tiny nit: avoid punctuation overload in small tooltips. shorter: "Rate limit hit. Retry in 1 minute. Upgrade for higher throughput."

kevin: accessibility: tooltips need proper role=tooltip and an accessible trigger (aria-describedby) for focusable elements. also screen readers benefit from full sentences; keep it readable.

nina: what about making CTA explicit in the tooltip when space allows? e.g., an inline link: "Retry in 1 minute — or <link>upgrade</link>". but need to think about click targets and keyboard behavior.

rafi: if we add a link, follow copy idea: "Retry in 1 minute. Upgrade plan" where "Upgrade plan" is a link. for very small screens, collapse to "Rate limit. Retry in 1m."

jules: microcopy principles: 1) use numerals for short times ("1m" vs "1 minute"?), 2) use consistent verbs: Retry vs Try again, 3) avoid abbreviations in a11y text. so maybe visible copy: "Rate limit. Retry in 1m. Upgrade plan" but aria-label: "Rate limit reached. Retry in one minute. Upgrade plan."

kevin: exactly. aria-label should expand abbreviations: `Retry in one minute. Upgrade plan to increase throughput.` also ensure link has descriptive text not just "Upgrade" (eg "View pricing and upgrades").

design-bot: tooltip checklist: keep under 150 chars, ensure focusable trigger, provide persistent dismissal for keyboard users, provide aria-describedby or aria-labelledby mapping, avoid relying solely on hover. for dynamic cooldowns use live region updates (aria-live="polite").

nina: ok final proposal (visible tooltip):
"Rate limit. Retry in 1m. View upgrade options."

aria-label: "Rate limit reached. Retry in one minute. View upgrade options to increase throughput."

nina: i'll update Figma with both visible and aria copy and add a small responsive rule: <=320px show "Rate limit. Retry in 1m.". i'll also add a dev note to use aria-live for the countdown. flagging to PM for product policy if we show specific time windows.

rafi: :thumbsup: good balance.

jules: small ask: make the link text `View upgrade options` so it reads well in screen readers.

kevin: i'll follow up with an accessibility PR template for the tooltip component.

nina: thanks all, landing this now.
